home.title: First Law Energies · Batteries that cut your company's power bill
home.description: A battery behind your meter cuts peak demand and your electricity bill. First Law sizes, installs and operates it, with no investment on your side, and shows the arithmetic line by line.

hero.letreiro: Energy storage for industry and commerce
hero.p: A battery behind your meter cuts peak demand and moves energy from the expensive hour to the cheap one. No investment on your side: First Law sizes, installs and operates it, and is paid out of the savings the battery generates.

bullets.b1: Battery sized with the model we use for the power grid
bullets.b2: Behind your meter, nothing injected into the grid
bullets.b3: If it does not pay off, we say so

hero.linha: Group A · Green or Blue tariff · free or regulated market
hero.mapa_sr: Map of Brazil with the high voltage lines drawn in line and the current running over them.

faz.legenda_celular: Peak 6 pm to 9 pm, charge 1 am to 9 am. Dashed line: no battery. Solid line: with battery.
faz.curva_aria: Chart of the plant's demand over the day. Without a battery, demand rises to 1,900 kW at peak, 6 pm to 9 pm. With a battery, charged from 1 am to 9 am and discharged at peak, measured demand drops to 900 kW.

i1.p: It discharges during the three peak hours. Measured demand drops, you contract less and stop paying overrun charges.

i2.p: It charges off-peak and gives the energy back at peak. On the Green tariff, every MWh moved out of the peak stops paying the utility's peak tariff. In the free market, add the price difference of each hour, according to your contract.

i3.h3: Keeps the plant running when the grid goes down
i3.p: While the generator starts, the battery carries the load. No line stoppage.

como.letreiro: From your bill to savings on the bill

p1.p: Twelve bills as PDF, through the form or by email. No strings attached.

p2.p: Within 5 business days: battery power, peak demand reduction and monthly savings, line by line, with the tariffs from your own bill.

p3.p: We install and operate the battery. You follow the savings every month and they pay for the battery.

diag.h2: With the bills, the number stops being an estimate.
diag.p: Within 5 business days you receive battery size, peak demand reduction and monthly savings. No commitment. If it does not pay off, we say so.
